verdict.rationale: Crossmint is API-first: wallets run "through a single API" covering every wallet operation, and the embedded checkout UI has a headless REST equivalent with "full control of the user experience" that also works outside a browser. Onramp, offramp, agent cards and agent checkouts all have documented API endpoints, backed by an interactive API reference and webhooks. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that the dashboard/console has API parity (e.g. project or API-key management via API), no published OpenAPI spec at standard paths, agent checkouts lack webhooks in v1, and no independent hands-on corroboration.
